reportRequirements: Every private gate report must repeat this index's release, sourceCommit, apkSha256 and backendBundleSha256 exactly. Replacing either accepted artifact requires matching new acceptance reports; a version label alone is insufficient.

gates.required: Connected rails, signed callbacks, failures/reversals and matched settlement evidence.
Validated actual PAD/identity, population/device calibration and safe fallback.
Actual staff factors/enforcement, maker-checker and governed recovery acceptance.
Timed isolated hosted restore including keys, ledger reconciliation and reset uncertainty.
Representative signed handset installation/upgrade and critical journey matrix.
Independent security assessment and measured declared launch/growth workload.
